title: Multistage Contextual Optimization for Vehicle Repositioning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22330v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ride-hailing platforms reposition idle vehicles to improve spatial supply-demand balances. This problem is prediction-driven and multistage: at each stage, the platform forecasts future demand, executes current decisions, and uses the resulting state to initialize the next stage. We formulate a multistage linear program (LP) with a macroscopic fundamental diagram (MFD) linking accumulation to trip completion. We then develop a multistage contextual optimization approach that uses decision performance to train the prediction model. The learning problem combines multiple coupled stages, context that depends on earlier decisions, and predictions that affect the objective, the constraint matrix, and the right-hand side of the LP. We derive the exact gradient, which has three parts: parameters change forecasts and hence decisions; earlier decisions change the current decision through the inherited state; and this state also changes forecasts

translated_title: 面向车辆重定位的多阶段上下文优化
translated_abstract: 网约车平台通过重新定位闲置车辆来改善空间供需平衡。该问题是预测驱动且多阶段的：在每个阶段，平台预测未来需求、执行当前决策，并利用所产生状态来初始化下一阶段。我们构建了一个多阶段线性规划（LP），其中宏观基本图（MFD）将车辆累积量与行程完成率联系起来。随后，我们开发了一种多阶段上下文优化方法，利用决策性能来训练预测模型。该学习问题结合了多个相互耦合的阶段、依赖于先前决策的上下文，以及同时影响线性规划目标函数、约束矩阵和右端项的预测。我们推导出了精确的梯度，该梯度包含三个部分：参数变化会影响预测进而影响决策；先前的决策通过继承状态影响当前决策；该状态也会改变预测。
tldr: 本文提出一种多阶段上下文优化方法，将车辆重定位建模为含宏观基本图的多阶段线性规划，并利用决策性能的精确梯度训练预测模型，以优化网约车平台的供需平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multistage contextual optimization approach that formulates vehicle repositioning as a multistage linear program with a macroscopic fundamental diagram and trains prediction models via exact gradients derived from decision performance to improve supply-demand balance on ride-hailing platforms.
